text: OpenAI dots: before, your ChatGPT would stop, wait for you; now your dot works twenty-four seven, but how, at what risk, in sixty seconds?
Here's how, in one shop you run.
Old ChatGPT, even twenty twenty-five's agent mode, was the clerk at the counter: you ring, it does that one task, then waits for the next ring.
Go home, and no new work starts.
Now a dot works the night shift.
It has its own desk, a cloud computer, and your goals pinned on the wall.
While you're away, it reads your connected apps, but it can't send a thing.
Morning, a note: you forgot an invoice; it's ready; send it?
And changing a password always stays with you.
Its own computer, working toward your goals.
Away, it only reads; it asks before sensitive steps.
It still makes mistakes, so check its work.
The shop never closes now, but the keys are still yours.
